facts.fact: The Appropriation Act, 2025 (Act No. 28, assented 23 December 2025) authorises expenditure for 2026; its catalogue line gives Smart Zambia e-government K1.15bn, ICT development K566.8m and legal identity K325.5m, the schedule figures themselves not being on the page.
facts.system: Smart Zambia e-government and ICT development programmes, 2026 appropriation

note: Companion page; figures come only from its catalogue line, no prior-year figure in this document so no rose or fell, no spending.
